attempts.prompt:
One continuous eight-second locked-off tripod shot in the man's living room at evening lamplight. The camera does not move: no pan, tilt, zoom, drift or reframing, and no cuts. Preserve the supplied starting frame exactly: the same man, short brown hair, stubble, grey sweater, jeans, seated on the sofa; the phone in his right hand with its back toward camera; lamp, mug, shelves, window.

He stays seated and looks down at the phone. With his thumb he scrolls the phone slowly, stops, looks at it for a moment as if comparing two options, then scrolls a little again and pauses, thumb resting on the phone. His expression is calm and thoughtful.

He keeps looking at the phone the whole time. The phone screen always faces away from camera and is never visible. He does not stand, does not look at camera, does not speak, no lip movement. No new person, prop, text, logo or sound. Real-time motion.

cost_basis: Fal listed $0.112/s x 8 s; account debit not returned by the API
honest_note: Guest on the sofa scrolls and pauses with his thumb; subtle but readable. Phone back to camera, no logo. Likeness to the ST01 guest is plausible, not verifiable (ST01 shows little of his face).
audio_offset_windows: not applicable: film takes carry no generated audio; audio is the sample-exact master excerpt
checks_scope: Checked: frame count, 1280x720 24 fps, PCM intermediate audio sample-exact vs master excerpt, AAC corr at zero lag, uniform frames, 2 fps and 4 fps contact sheets of the raw take plus detail crops at the action. Not judged: playback at speed with the narration, full-resolution texture flicker, whether the viewer reads the intended inference.
